title: Compact terminal-first quickstart: visual kit + upgrade state snapshots
creator: Maya Patel
description: Deliver a compact visual kit and production screenshots aimed at teams that prefer a terminal-first Private/VPC onboarding. This ticket covers small-screen-friendly illustrations, micro-interaction frames for CLI <> Console toggle, terminal output snapshots (success / warning / rollback), and upgrade-state UI thumbnails that will appear in the docs and the quickstart modal. The goal is to give engineers an immediate sense of progress and recovery options when installing or upgrading the private appliance or VPC connector.
goals: Create a set of 8 visual assets (SVG + PNG) for use in docs and the quickstart modal
Produce 3 terminal output mockups showing success, transient warning, and rollback completion
Design compact progress chips and microcopy patterns for small screens and CLI-heavy flows
Provide annotations and copy for docs explaining when to choose CLI vs Console install
scope: Illustrations: 4 compact step cards (network-check, key-unwrap, agent-register, finalization)
Terminal mockups: 3 variants (green success, amber warning with hint, rollback completed)
Two modal screenshots: CLI-first quickstart and Console-first quickstart
Export assets in Figma and prepare PNGs sized for docs (600px wide)
out_of_scope: Major redesign of the onboarding console UI itself
Animated Lottie files (static PNG/SVG only for this ticket)
acceptance_criteria: All 8 assets uploaded to Figma project and Drive folder with naming convention: onboarding/private/terminal/*
Terminal mockups use realistic command outputs taken from engineering logs (sanitized) and approved by ENG
QA signoff that compact progress chips meet AA contrast and have accessible labels for screen readers
Docs team confirms images fit the quickstart doc templates without cropping or layout regressions
assets_needed: Design system tokens for compact chips: console-design/redwood-token-compact.json
Photoreal device mock (small laptop) for hero screenshot
dependencies: ENG-40221 (sanitized CLI logs and final command semantics)
DES-84000 (design tokens update for compact chips)
